footer.description: Connecting orphanage students with volunteer tutors for peer-to-peer learning and growth.
footer.tagline: Made with care for children everywhere

home.heroSubtitle: Connect with certified volunteer teachers worldwide. We bridge the gap between passionate educators and orphaned children eager to learn — completely free, forever.
home.missionDesc1: Millions of children worldwide lack access to quality education simply because of their circumstances. TutorBridge was built from one idea: connect those who want to teach with those who desperately need to learn — removing every barrier in between.
home.missionDesc2: Our platform provides a safe, monitored environment where certified educators donate a few hours a week to tutor children in orphanages via high-quality video sessions.
home.missionPoint1: Strictly vetted and certified volunteer educators
home.missionPoint2: Structured curricula aligned with local needs
home.missionPoint3: Zero cost to the orphanages or students
home.missionQuote: I want to be a doctor so I can help people in my village.
home.subjectsDesc: From basic literacy to advanced mathematics — our volunteers cover a wide array of subjects to ensure a well-rounded, world-class education.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Get started in four simple steps
home.step1Desc: Students get instant access. Tutors complete a simple verified profile in minutes.
home.step2Desc: Explore live and recorded classes across 8+ subjects. Filter by level and schedule.
home.step3Desc: Join Zoom sessions, watch recordings, complete quizzes, submit assignments — all in one place.
home.step4Desc: Receive QR-verified certificates as lasting proof of every course you complete.
home.teachersDesc: Certified professionals who dedicate their time to make a lasting impact. They aren't just teaching — they're mentoring.
home.testimonial1Text: TutorBridge didn't just give our children education; it gave them hope. The teachers are incredibly dedicated and treat our kids like their own.
home.testimonial2Text: Volunteering here is the highlight of my week. Seeing a child's face light up when they finally understand a concept is priceless.
home.testimonial3Text: I never thought I could learn coding from someone across the world. My teacher believes in me, and now I believe in myself.
home.featuresDesc: Every feature designed to empower children and protect their journey
home.featureChildSafeDesc: Designed for orphanage environments with full safeguarding protocols and coordinator oversight.
home.featureAIDesc: Our AI assistant provides instant homework help, lesson summaries, and personalised practice 24/7.
home.featureCertsDesc: Completed courses earn digitally-signed certificates with unique QR codes — lifelong proof.
home.featureMultilingualDesc: Classes in Urdu, English, and regional languages — no child is left behind due to language barriers.
home.featureLiveDesc: Attend interactive Zoom sessions live or watch recordings anytime — learning on the student's terms.
home.featureExpertsDesc: Every tutor is verified, background-checked, and trained in child-appropriate teaching methods.
home.ctaDesc: Whether you have an hour a week or ten, your knowledge is the most valuable gift you can give. Join our global community of educators today.
